title: デビュー戦の後に・背水の陣

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder turns heads in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And yet, the media only see her as the next Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if to fan the flames, Grass Wonder declares her intentions to run in the Asahi Hai F.S., where Maruzensky set an all-time record.
